summary: Verified user's bug report: 'preview not available, cannot sign in.' Result: preview + auth work end-to-end. Preview URL returns 200, signup created a fresh Firebase user (qa-20260115-1786390302@example.com / demo1234), /api/auth/sync returned 200 with a valid user profile, session persisted, /login redirected an authenticated user to /feed, and /leagues loaded (200 on /api/leagues + /api/leagues/browse). No console errors, no page errors, no 4xx/5xx on any API. Conclusion: sign-in is NOT broken server-side. The user is almost certainly hitting a stale browser cache / old service-worker — exactly the situation the yellow 'Sign-in trouble' banner on /signup warns about. Recommend the user open the site in an incognito/private window OR clear site data for the preview host, then reload.
action_items: No code fix required. Reply to the user with the cache-clear guidance already surfaced by the yellow 'Sign-in trouble' banner on the Signup page (open in a private/incognito window, or clear site data for league-manager-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com and reload).
Optional polish: consider also showing the same yellow 'Sign-in trouble' banner on the Login page (currently only on Signup) so users who go straight to /login see it too.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup.jsx already has a helpful 'Sign-in trouble' cache-hint banner; Login.jsx does not — mirror it there for parity.
No other issues observed during this run; recent BracketView / canvas-confetti / RoundRecapPoster additions did not surface any console or network errors during auth flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth (Firebase mode) is fully working on the preview URL. If user re-reports 'cannot sign in', first ask which browser/device and whether they've tried an incognito window — a service-worker / cached bundle mismatch has been the recurring root cause. The yellow banner in Signup.jsx exists specifically for this. Verified endpoints during signup+login: GET /api/config (200), POST /api/auth/sync (200), GET /api/inbox (200), PUT /api/users/me (200), GET /api/feed (200), GET /api/leagues (200), GET /api/leagues/browse (200), GET /api/news (200), GET /api/feed/top-niced-this-week (200).
rca of the issue: User-reported 'preview not available / cannot sign in' could NOT be reproduced. Backend + frontend + Firebase auth all functional. Preview URL responds 200. Root cause is client-side: stale cached JS bundle or old service worker on the user's browser pointing at an outdated build. Mitigation: hard-refresh (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R), open in incognito, or DevTools → Application → Clear storage → Clear site data, then reload. This matches the guidance already visible in the yellow 'Sign-in trouble' banner on the /signup page (Signup.jsx).
